_comment: Maps engine options ('cleaner_id.option_id', fnmatch patterns) to friendly categories. The first matching category wins. Options that match nothing appear only in Custom mode.

disk.label: Recycle Bin
disk.description: Files you deleted that are still kept in the Recycle Bin.

disk.label: Windows temp files
disk.description: Temporary files Windows created and no longer needs.

disk.label: Program temp files
disk.description: Temporary files left behind by installed programs.

disk.label: Program log files
disk.description: Diagnostic logs written by installed programs.

disk.label: Crash reports and memory dumps
disk.description: Reports saved after programs or Windows crashed.

disk.label: Windows cache files
disk.description: Thumbnail and other caches Windows can rebuild.

disk.label: Program cache files
disk.description: Caches that programs rebuild when needed.

disk.label: Program download files
disk.description: Installers and updates that programs downloaded and already used.

disk.label: Windows Update leftovers
disk.description: Old update files. Cleaning may need administrator rights.

disk.label: System caches
disk.description: Prefetch, MUICache and DNS cache. Windows rebuilds them, so the first start of some apps may be slower.

disk.label: Recent activity
disk.description: Lists of recently opened files, searches and commands.

disk.label: Clipboard
disk.description: Whatever is currently copied to the clipboard.

disk.label: Compact app databases
disk.description: Shrinks app databases without deleting anything.
